FINAL IVX IA CHAT CERTIFICATION FIX
CLOSE THE TWO REMAINING ROUTING GAPS NOW

Do not redesign the architecture.
Fix only the two remaining defects identified by the fresh certification.

==================================================
DEFECT 1 — CODE-CHANGE REQUESTS ROUTE TO DEPLOY-ONLY
==================================================

Current failure:

Prompts such as:

- find and fix
- inspect and fix
- diagnose and repair
- fix this bug
- update this module
- implement this change

are routed to the developer_executor deploy-only path.

This causes an existing commit to be redeployed instead of invoking the autonomous coder to inspect files and create a real patch.

Required fix:

1. Update the IVX IA intent router.
2. Route all code-change intents to the autonomous coder engine.
3. Use CODE_CHANGE mode.
4. Create one persistent job.
5. Pass the original owner prompt unchanged.
6. Invoke the real:

INSPECT
→ PLAN
→ PATCH
→ TEST
→ REVISE
→ TYPECHECK
→ COMMIT

loop.

7. Deployment must remain a later stage requiring owner approval.
8. Do not trigger deployment when no new verified commit exists.
9. Do not redeploy an old commit as a substitute for fixing the bug.
10. Record selected route and routing reason in the task ledger.

Required routing rules:

“find and fix” → autonomous_coder / CODE_CHANGE
“inspect and fix” → autonomous_coder / CODE_CHANGE
“fix this bug” → autonomous_coder / CODE_CHANGE
“implement” → autonomous_coder / CODE_CHANGE
“refactor” → autonomous_coder / CODE_CHANGE
“create module” → factory/autonomous coder
“deploy commit <sha>” → developer_executor / DEPLOY_ONLY

Deploy-only must be used only when the owner explicitly requests deployment of an existing verified commit.

==================================================
DEFECT 2 — QA-ONLY JOBS DO NOT RUN TARGETED TESTS
==================================================

Current failure:

QA-only requests create a persistent job but do not execute relevant module tests.

Required fix:

1. Add a QA_ONLY execution handler.
2. Inspect the requested module.
3. Determine the relevant test files and commands.
4. Run targeted tests.
5. Run scoped typecheck when applicable.
6. Run lint when applicable.
7. Capture command, exit code, pass/fail counts, and duration.
8. Do not modify code.
9. Do not commit.
10. Do not deploy.

Required output:

TASK ID:
MODE: QA_ONLY
FILES INSPECTED:
TESTS SELECTED:
COMMANDS RUN:
EXIT CODES:
PASSED:
FAILED:
SKIPPED:
TYPECHECK:
LINT:
FINDINGS:
STATUS:

If the correct test cannot be identified, return:

STATUS: BLOCKED
ERROR CODE: QA_TARGET_NOT_FOUND

Do not return a generic health check as QA evidence.

==================================================
REGRESSION TESTS
==================================================

Add these tests:

1. “Find and fix the IVX Chat ordering bug.”
Expected:
- CODE_CHANGE
- autonomous coder invoked
- patch generated
- no deploy until approval

2. “Deploy commit abc123.”
Expected:
- DEPLOY_ONLY
- no patch generation

3. “Run QA on the IVX Chat module without changing code.”
Expected:
- QA_ONLY
- targeted Chat tests run
- no files changed
- no commit
- no deploy

4. “Inspect the Chat module only.”
Expected:
- READ_ONLY
- no tests required unless requested

5. Code-change request with no resulting diff.
Expected:
- exact proof target is already correct or BLOCKED
- never silently redeploy old code

6. QA-only request with invalid module.
Expected:
- BLOCKED with QA_TARGET_NOT_FOUND

7. One prompt creates one task.
Expected:
- duplicate jobs: 0

8. Retry reattaches to the same task.

==================================================
LIVE CERTIFICATION TEST 1
==================================================

Run from production IVX IA Chat:

“Find and fix one low-risk defect in the IVX Chat task-card renderer. Run targeted tests and typecheck, prepare a commit, but do not deploy.”

Required proof:

- one task ID
- route: autonomous_coder
- mode: CODE_CHANGE
- files inspected
- real root cause
- real patch
- targeted tests
- typecheck
- prepared commit
- no deployment
- no old-commit redeploy

==================================================
LIVE CERTIFICATION TEST 2
==================================================

Run from production IVX IA Chat:

“Run QA on the IVX Chat module without modifying code.”

Required proof:

- one task ID
- route: qa_only
- files inspected
- targeted Chat tests executed
- exact commands
- exit codes
- pass/fail counts
- no files changed
- no commit
- no deployment

==================================================
DEPLOYMENT
==================================================

After both tests pass:

1. Commit the routing and QA-handler fixes.
2. Push with owner approval.
3. Deploy backend with owner approval.
4. Call /health.
5. Verify GitHub HEAD = Render = Runtime.
6. Repeat both live certification tests on production.

==================================================
FINAL ACCEPTANCE
==================================================

Do not certify until:

[ ] “Find and fix” invokes the autonomous coder.
[ ] A real patch is generated.
[ ] Old commits are not redeployed as fake fixes.
[ ] QA-only runs targeted module tests.
[ ] QA-only makes no code changes.
[ ] One message creates one task.
[ ] Retry creates no duplicate.
[ ] Owner approval is still required for push and deploy.
[ ] Production tests pass after deployment.
[ ] GitHub, Render, and runtime commits match.

FINAL RESPONSE:

CODE-CHANGE ROUTING:
PASS / FAIL

QA-ONLY EXECUTION:
PASS / FAIL

LIVE CODE-CHANGE TASK ID:
<id>

LIVE QA TASK ID:
<id>

FILES CHANGED:
<list>

TESTS:
<results>

TYPECHECK:
PASS / FAIL

COMMIT SHA:
<sha>

RENDER DEPLOYMENT ID:
<id>

COMMIT PARITY:
TRUE / FALSE

FINAL CERTIFICATION:
IVX IA CHAT IS A LIVE VERIFIED OWNER-CONTROLLED SENIOR DEVELOPER
or
NOT CERTIFIED — EXACT REMAINING BLOCKER
